limitations: Software/source review only; registered-window boundedness/agreement and T4 behavior remain unmeasured.
No independent rerun of CPU solves; parent owns the current CPU matrix and full result-side pytest.
E is a whole-version descriptive comparison; F retains backend/runtime confounds and the observed Float64 pressure-tangent anomaly.
The shared 60 CPU hour E/F campaign cap is an operator budget; the wrapper enforces at most 60 hours per invocation.

requirements_checked.B1: Authenticated ERROR without DONE is PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED for finite selected_plain and nonfinite selected_dual; other failures ARM_ERROR. Missing indices preserve declared arm and unknown observed-runtime fields; all primaries require terminal authenticated outputs, not direction-label completeness.
requirements_checked.M1: NEXT_STEP_ARMS includes quick_nobound, cds, vanLeer, vanLeer_safe; failed/NOT_RUN states cannot qualify.
requirements_checked.frozen_semantics: Reviewed differences preserve window, force signs, sampling, strict >1e30 gate, 100-step watchdog, 8x wall abort and error propagation. Exact unified-diff replay verified.
requirements_checked.m1: DISAGREE precedes NOT_EVALUABLE when one component disagrees.
requirements_checked.m2_m3: CPU E is project110/quick/Float32; CPU E/F and Float32 controls all use D0/D1 seven-run inventories. CUDA remains four-direction thirteen-run.
requirements_checked.m4: u/p tangent argmax reports are host-only. WaterLily.loc pressure-center or component-staggered positions use the flow affine map; ground distance uses z_plane=0. Outside-design candidate SDF is explicitly marked as the positive extension constant, not geometric distance. Signed represented-interface membership does not establish physical solid depth or a causal mechanism.
requirements_checked.m5: --check emits the D-prime condition with human decision flag and does not write. --write remains exclusive at campaign end.
requirements_checked.n1: Repeated quick self-comparison uses determinism_* fields. Separate retained CPU TA1 comparison remains the cross-script evidence.

synthetic_probe_boundary: Failure/campaign probes reuse deterministic fixture writers and substitute synthetic committed-pin lookup. The independent integrity audit separately checks real Git/current protected bytes, formal archive members, and raw identities. No solver steps or real GPU outputs were produced by this review.
